instruction.name: vmsknz.b
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, for each 8-bit element in `a`, set the bit at that element's index within the lane to one if the element is non-zero, otherwise zero; the remaining bits of the lane are zero.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vmsknz.b $vr0, $vr8; vmsknz.b $vr1, $vr9; vmsknz.b $vr2, $vr10; vmsknz.b $vr3, $vr11; vmsknz.b $vr4, $vr12; vmsknz.b $vr5, $vr13; vmsknz.b $vr6, $vr14; vmsknz.b $vr7, $vr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vmsknz.b $vr0, $vr8; vmsknz.b $vr1, $vr9; vmsknz.b $vr2, $vr10; vmsknz.b $vr3, $vr11; vmsknz.b $vr4, $vr12; vmsknz.b $vr5, $vr13; vmsknz.b $vr6, $vr14; vmsknz.b $vr7, $vr15'

notes: LSX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
